description: This file defines a specific culture configuration for the Date.js library, named "en-029" (English Caribbean). It includes localization details such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing date strings, time zone info, and extends the Date prototype with various utility functions pertinent to date manipulation and parsing.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight (00:00:00).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two Date objects, returns -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.
